findings.title: The empty-station callout is far from the marker it describes

location.description: The "Stations now" map: the "Canal Basin, 0 bikes" callout at top left and the single blue marker near the centre.

findings.viewer_experience: The viewer has to guess that the top-left callout belongs to the blue marker, because nothing joins them and a van callout sits close to the marker instead.

current.value: A callout at the top left and a lone blue dot in the middle with no link between them.

findings.target: Each callout is clearly tied to the marker it describes.
findings.fix_direction: Tie each callout to its marker, for example with a leader line or by placing it next to it.

closed_when.check: Look at the map: each callout clearly belongs to one marker.

findings.title: Large gap between station names and the numbers

location.description: The "Stations to restock" table, between Area and Bikes.

findings.viewer_experience: The eye has to cross a wide empty gap to read each station's bike count.

current.value: A wide empty area between the Area column and the Bikes column.

findings.target: Each row reads as one line without effort.
findings.fix_direction: Pull the number columns closer to the names.

closed_when.check: Look at the table: each station and its counts read as one line.
